name: Text Document Analysis
description: Analyze a text document: chunk, extract keywords/topics with the fallback walk, build chunk graphs, persist under the project, link to existing.

steps.description: If the document is a PDF/DOCX/ODT/PPTX/XLSX/RTF file, extract its real text first. For plain text input nothing is needed.
steps.name: extract_document_text

steps.description: Normalize and chunk the document with no-overlap boundaries. Consumes the document text (extracted when the provider step produced any); hands on the chunks. (Walk Stage 2 already normalizes the request text.)
steps.name: chunk_and_normalize

steps.description: Extract keywords and topics from each chunk: meaningful terms only, no filler. Hands on keywords and topics.
steps.name: extract_terms

steps.description: State which existing material each chunk relates to and what a fresh-process retrieval of this document's graph must return. Hands on the relationships and the verification note. (Edge writing is the walk's, Stage 4.)
steps.name: link_and_verify

missing_capabilities: run a test or fresh-process verification against the host (e.g. QueryGraph from a new process, a regression test run)

walk_covered.covered_by: walk Stage 4 (graph creation: per-modality structural graphs, links and updates are made by the walk)

1.name: chunk_and_normalize
1.legacy_description: Normalize and chunk the document (no-overlap boundaries)

2.name: extract_terms
2.legacy_description: Extract keywords/topics via pipeline 9 with the OZONE_FALLBACK_CHAIN walk and deterministic frequency tier

3.name: build_and_persist
3.legacy_description: CreateGraph per chunk; persist ModalityGraph containers parented under the project

4.name: link_and_verify
4.legacy_description: link_to_existing wires relationship-neighborhood edges; fresh-process QueryGraph verifies
